reception: In the citing literature the transformation survives as a name: works reference unroll-and-squash itself, usually in a sentence crediting it as a way to pipeline loops under resource constraints. The high-level-synthesis literature on loop pipelining places it among the transformations it builds past, and signal-processing implementations on FPGAs apply it to their kernels. The record is nearly all differentiation and technique credit rather than reuse of an artifact — the reception of a transformation that entered the compiler vocabulary and is engaged wherever loop pipelining is surveyed.
